positions.name: QuantumDBMigrationJustification
positions.frame: On what grounds is the PostgreSQL→QuantumDB migration decision justified — and does the record's framing of that basis stay stable as it moves from spoken commitment to written summary?
positions.why: Both expressions state the same decision (PostgreSQL→QuantumDB) through the same justificatory move — quantified performance gain paired with cost reduction, read across dimensions as market-pricing relational framing and rational-persuasion/informational power framing in both. src-1 performs it as a first-person settled commitment ('We're switching...'); src-2 re-records it as a flat triadic bullet summary with the added Q3 2026 timeline. The directional read holds across both: the migration is justified by evidence-of-benefit, not authority or urgency, whether spoken or written down — with the tension that src-1 is live commitment-language and src-2 is a distanced, authorless-principal summary of it (footing shows animator/author Xena, principal null), so the same justification is carried at two different distances from the original speaker.
